name: app-treino
description: Monorepo do App Treino (web, API, mobile) preservado, com shell opcional da rede-social em apps/social.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @app-treino/shared && npm run dev --workspace @app-treino/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @app-treino/shared && npm run dev --workspace @app-treino/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @app-treino/shared && npm run dev --workspace @app-treino/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @app-treino/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
